Security

Smarter IP Defense. Human-Led. AI-Accelerated.

Midnight AI accelerates trademark, copyright, and IP enforcement at global scale. Automate takedowns, filings, and compliance workflows—while retaining full oversight and manual control whenever you need it.

Accelerated Enforcement

Choose your level of automation while still having manual oversight for precise control.

Global IP Protection

Enforce trademark, copyright, and brand rights across multiple jurisdictions.

Evidence Gathering for Legal Action

Collect and preserve legal-grade evidence to support escalated legal proceedings when needed.

Deepfakes

Deepfakes & Impersonation Protection

In 2024 alone, over 10 million synthetic videos circulated, causing $1.3 billion in damages. Midnight AI detects and neutralises deepfakes that exploit your brand, spokespersons, or executives, while also identifying impersonation attempts on social media and other digital platforms.

Advanced AI Detection

Expose & remove even the most sophisticated manipulations and fake identities.

Proactive Alerts

Detect and remove fraudulent profiles before they damage your brand.

Legal & Reputational Safeguards

Integrate AI-powered monitoring into your compliance strategy for rapid enforcement.
